blocks.text: Defy Boring with the iconic Pebble Keys 2 K380s Bluetooth keyboard. The Pebble 2 collection of wireless keyboards comes in a choice of fresh colors – made with recycled plastic (1). Pick the one that suits your vibe. Its minimalist, lightweight, streamlined shape and sleek curves make it as iconic as you and super portable to take it wherever you go. Easily switch between up to 3 wireless devices across OSs (Windows, macOS, iPadOS, iOS, ChromeOS, Android) with a press of the Easy-Switch buttons. The wireless keyboard also features Fn shortcut keys such as screen capture, search, voice dictation and the emoji menu to free up your time. You can customize these 10 Fn shortcut keys to do everyday actions like opening your favorite applications instantly, assigning keyboard shortcuts (copy/paste) and much more with Logi Options+ app (2). Welcome to the comfort zone. The Pebble Keys 2 K380s Keyboard offers comfy and precise typing with scooped, low-profile keys for a familiar and quiet, laptop-like typing experience. This wireless Bluetooth keyboard gives you hours of use with a 3-year battery (3), auto-sleep power-saving mode and 50% more battery life (4) to keep you going for longer. Batteries included.
